items.text: UK Staffy puppy typically £750 to £2,500. Unregistered or crossbreed £300–£700; purebred without papers £700–£1,000; KC registered £1,400–£2,500; popular colours (solid blue or red) £1,800–£2,750+. KC registration, coat colour and breeder reputation (L-2-HGA and HC-HSF4 screening) drive price. PDSA: at least £80 a month to keep. Browse Pets4Homes or Staffie Owners, or breed rescues (adoption fees around £200–£300).
